sprite: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: in-game pixel-art asset sheet for Outpost, a modern zombie survival game. Create a STRICT LOW RESOLUTION PIXEL ART sprite sheet with a transparent background. 4 columns by 4 rows of equally spaced character sprites, each in its own square cell. Each sprite is designed as ONLY 16 pixels wide and 24 pixels tall in the underlying pixel grid, enlarged with hard square pixel edges to fill the cell; simple chunky clusters, 8-12 colors per character, 1-pixel dark outlines. This MUST look like Core Keeper or Stardew Valley small in-game sprites, NOT high-detail painted pixel illustrations, NOT realistic anatomy. Big compact heads and short bodies, elevated top-down front/side/back view, not isometric. Every sprite completely isolated, no floor, no shadow, no words, no grid lines. Rows: 1 civilian survivor wearing red cap, blue jacket, gray pants, brown shoes. 2 soldier green helmet and olive uniform with small backpack. 3 police survivor navy cap and navy uniform. 4 zombie with ragged olive shirt, gray-green face, dark trousers. Columns for EVERY row: front facing down; right side facing right; back facing up; left side facing left. Neutral relaxed arms at sides, empty hands, planted feet. Exact same character height and head proportions all 16 sprites, aligned bottom centers in a regular 4x4 grid. Only tiny two-pixel eyes, no nose or detailed faces; clothing must read from 2-3 broad color shapes. Big readable pixel clusters, absolutely no tiny dither, no smooth gradients, no painterly textures, no anti-aliasing. Alpha transparent.

gunviews: Create an original transparent PNG pixel-art directional firearm sprite sheet for a top-down zombie survival game. Very chunky low-resolution pixel art, each weapon intended only 16 by 10 native pixels, flat muted olive/steel colors, dark one-pixel outlines, 3 shades maximum per material. Absolutely no hands or characters, no labels, no shadows, no antialiasing, no realism. Exactly 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 isolated weapons, large transparent gutters. Each row depicts the SAME weapon facing four different compass directions for a tilted orthographic overhead game camera: column 1 pointing RIGHT with side/top visible, column 2 pointing DOWN toward the viewer with foreshortened barrel and symmetric top of receiver visible, column 3 pointing UP away from viewer with stock nearest viewer and barrel beyond, column 4 pointing LEFT side/top view. These must be distinct correct perspective views, NOT sideways guns simply rotated in the image plane. Row 1 compact pistol. Row 2 olive M4 assault rifle with short black magazine. Row 3 long sniper rifle with dark small scope. Row 4 tubular olive rocket launcher. Strong readable toy-sized silhouettes. Grip/stock nearest the rear of the weapon, muzzle at the opposite end. Crisp square pixel clusters, restrained detail appropriate to 16px weapons.
